entities.name: Farris of the Anvil
entities.description: Vulshok warrior and leader of the Anvil tribe from the Oxidda Chain on Mirrodin who became the Traitor of Oxid Ridge.

entities.name: Anvil tribe
entities.description: Vulshok tribe from Mirrodin's Oxidda Chain.

entities.name: Trinu of the Helm tribe
entities.description: Ally of Farris who survived the ambush.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of Mirrodin who attacked the Anvil tribe.

entities.name: Oxid Ridge
entities.description: Site of the Phyrexian invasion where Farris detonated a bomb.

entities.name: Sharaia
entities.description: Farris's sister, to whom he addresses letters.

events.summary: A meeting with a Shield Tribe representative was ambushed by Phyrexian-affiliated beasts; only five survived.
Farris defended the Anvil settlement from Phyrexians and sought help from goblins, ogres and Trinu.
events.quote: he was forced to defend it from an army of attacking Phyrexians

events.summary: Farris detonated a bomb at Oxid Ridge, killing Phyrexians and many allies, was captured, escaped, and took the title Traitor of Oxid Ridge.
events.quote: he assumed the title "Traitor of Oxid Ridge"

relations.quote: a woman named Sharaia , his sister
his ally, Trinu of the Helm tribe
decided to roam the land hunting for Phyrexians
